title: Emrys and the Witness
author: M. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Noor Underhill, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
